change_summary: Expose the root-only Project boundary before mutation so Agents build deeper Work Models with semantic branch Pages and avoid guaranteed project-nesting failures.

canonical_skill.note: The shared Skill and API reference explain that Projects are root-level owners and deeper Work Models use semantic branch Pages and leaves.

server_contract.note: The shared contract and MCP descriptions expose root-only Project placement before an Agent attempts a move.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.28 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.3.

workspace_cli.note: CLI help now states that docs move accepts non-Project sources and Projects cannot be nested; both protected npm packages advance together to 0.1.0-beta.26.

help_center.note: Localized Developer and MCP Help guidance distinguish root-level Projects from deeper branch Pages and leaves.

package_setup.note: The existing package README already mirrors the bounded canonical-link rule; the compact Claude hook remains unchanged.

harness_and_mainline.note: The longitudinal live failure is retained as trigger evidence and the mainline records the non-nested Project topology contract.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover MCP descriptions, shared contract/version metadata, CLI help, localized guidance and package parity.
